x: Now turning to individual performances, in the major worldwide championships, seven Belgravians qualified for the World Athletic Championships; Sean Baldock, Tim Benjamin, Dwain Chambers, (who achieved a silver medal in the 4 x 100 m), Julie Hollman, Rachel King, Shelley Newman and Amy Spencer.

Rachel King, who has been running brilliantly indoors and out this year, was a class apart in the sprint hurdles where she won with 13.4 seconds as the second placed runner was still attacking the final flight of barriers.

Below: Rachel King, Amala Onuora, Michelle Nestor and Caroline Wilson joined forces to win the 4 x 100m relay at the Golden Jubilee Cup Semi-Final and help push the score along to a massive 313 out of a maximum possible of 342.
